name: branding-blue-monoline-kb-play-symbol-with-lowercase-kineticbolt
title: Electric blue monoline symbol combining a play triangle and a K/B with a lowercase 'kineticbolt' wordmark
whatItIs: A white square with an electric blue logo: a thin-line symbol where vertical bars, a triangle and a rounded notch form a K and B and a play button, beside a lowercase geometric sans 'kineticbolt'.
whatItMeans: Energetic and precise; the play triangle and bolt suggest motion and media.
techniques: Combine letters and a play button in one monoline symbol.
Pair with a lowercase geometric sans.

vocabulary.definition: Two initials merged into one mark.
Symbol and name side by side.
